description: Photon factorisation of x_- in H_3(q): does the photon form fix the scale (and so /q^3)?
method: exact sympy, generic q; irreps triv/sign/refl
verdict: scope (a) negative: chiral-photon products are never nonzero multiples of x_-; two-photon products give x_- at a continuously varying scale. The photon definition does not derive the /q^3 normaliser.
